subject.title: fix(agents): use currentAttemptAssistant for incomplete-turn classification

question: Is the PR's source-level before/after terminal fixture plus regression coverage sufficient proof for this classifier-only message-delivery fix, or should maintainers require a live channel reproduction before merge?
rationale: The patch is narrow and well-covered at source level, but it affects whether final assistant text is delivered normally or replaced by an incomplete-turn warning.

options.title: Accept Source-Level Proof
options.body: Merge after normal gates if maintainers accept the terminal fixture and regression tests as sufficient for this classifier-only path.

options.title: Request Live Channel Proof
options.body: Pause for a real configured agent/channel run that exercises `update_plan` followed by a `stopReason=stop` final answer before merge.

recommendation.title: Accept Source-Level Proof
recommendation.body: Merge after normal gates if maintainers accept the terminal fixture and regression tests as sufficient for this classifier-only path.
